summary: Applied 3 spec review repairs covering official source materialization, manifestless legacy preset migration, and locale/AGENTS precedence.

items.title: Official default source is not materializable after bundled deletion
items.rationale: Defined the official default source descriptor and test substitution rule.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints, requirements[R3], acceptance_criteria[2], clarifications, and overview decisions now name id `official-presets`, type `git`, and remote `git@github.com:SpreadWorks/senti-presets.git`.

items.title: Legacy preset migration omits manifestless override semantics
items.rationale: Defined migration semantics for explicit manifest, manifestless matching-provider, and manifestless bare-preset cases.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R4], acceptance_criteria[3], clarifications, overview decisions, and task T-2 now describe manifestless migration behavior.

items.title: Locale and AGENTS chain resolution lacks deterministic semantics
items.rationale: Defined project-local/template, multi-type, and leaf-to-root chain precedence for locale and AGENTS resolution.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R5], acceptance_criteria[4], clarifications, overview decisions, and task T-3 now cover locale and AGENTS precedence.
